exposure: active management from late second trimester
cohort: Women with gestational diabetes mellitus and normal pre-pregnancy body mass index
finding: Active management of gestational diabetes mellitus from the late second trimester in women with normal pre-pregnancy BMI improved blood glucose control, gestational weight gain, and pregnancy outcomes, including a lower incidence of fetal distress, caesarean section, large for gestational age infants, and abnormal placental ultrastructure.
mod_finding: The incidence of cesarean section was significantly lower in the active management group compared to the conventional care group.
